## pyOpenSci package tutorial

Please follow the pyOpenSci packaging tutorial:
<https://www.pyopensci.org/python-package-guide/tutorials/intro.html>.

Here are a few changes from the tutorial.

### Conda environments

We are __not__ using `hatch` for environment management.
Instead, you can start the tutorial with a conda environment:

```yaml
name: pyos
channels:
  - conda-forge
dependencies:
  - python>3.12
  - copier # optional if you want to use the base pyopensci template and follow along their tutorial

```

Remember to activate this environment before doing any packaging steps.

All your other dependencies will be in the `pyproject.toml` file under the `dependencies` section.

## Publishing

In the publishing step
(<https://www.pyopensci.org/python-package-guide/tutorials/publish-pypi.html#steps-for-publishing-a-python-package-on-testpypi-or-pypi>),
step 1 uses `hatch env create`.
You do not need to run this command or step.
